ops.text: 15.5 Performance Warranty; Remedy. Array warrants that (a) the Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner; (b) for 90 days following delivery, any software supplied by Array will conform to its documentation; and (c) for 30 days following performance of the Services, the Services will conform to the foregoing standard. Ono's remedy for breach of this warranty is repair, replacement or refund of the amounts paid for the non-conforming Services or software.

input.comment: [Playbook] We inserted an express performance warranty: the Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner, software will conform to its documentation for 90 days following delivery and the Services for 30 days following performance, with repair, replacement or refund as the remedy. Article 15 otherwise gives us only Effective Date representations and defers conformance to supply agreements not yet signed; the mutual disclaimer at 15.4 expressly preserves warranties set out in the Agreement.
input.summary: Insert 15.5 fallback performance warranty (professional and workmanlike Services; 90-day software conformance to documentation; 30-day Services period) with repair, replacement or refund remedy.
